recommended_design.composition: Trusted production composition passes the already-open sole JsonlLedger writer into HistoricalStudyVerifier as required keyword admission_spend_ledger for capture-capable construction. Reuse existing configured ServeRoot and genesis namespace across all verifier clones/restarts. No implicit tempfile, cwd/env fallback, path argument, caller factory, per-request store, second writer, or store setter. P4 facade compatibility must be explicitly considered in the approved migration.
recommended_design.store_identity: Pin writer and immutable namespace at construction through the existing opaque binding discipline. Single handle/map/default replacement must not redirect it. Pins validate association only; committed disk history is spend authority. Host-selected namespace is trusted configuration, never an admission request field. Arbitrary host/file deletion or deliberate namespace replacement is not prevented by an in-process development boundary.
recommended_design.admission_identity: Use an existing authority-verified selected action/final-replay admission reference (kind, schema, signed content digest), retained immutably with its verified binding context. Obtain it from the existing issued authority closure; extend that existing seam only as necessary to expose a read-only verified identity. Never promote structural preflight, consumed=True, caller self-hash, arbitrary six dicts, or canonical hashing alone into authority. Exact accessor/API must be frozen after owner migration approval and inspected against P4 before RED.
recommended_design.key: admission_use:v1: + canonical_hash({kind, schema, sha256} of the immutable verified admission reference). Namespace is the trusted ledger series, not a caller-selectable key component. No process/run/nonce/object-id/clock/constructor identity in this key. If scope distinguishes admissions, it must already be signed into that admission identity; do not append mutable scope to create extra spend rights.
recommended_design.body: New admission_use record, schema dskit.admission-use/v1; exact fields schema, admission_ref, binding_sha256. binding_sha256 hashes the retained verified plan/capture scope and is payload conflict evidence, never an alternate spend key. Request nonce/process stamp remain envelope/audit context, not permission identity. Default-deny body validation before write.
recommended_design.fold: Add admission_use once to production/vocab.py RECORD_KINDS and the SeriesState fold table with a non-economic validating handler. Preserve all existing snapshot/hash recipes. Reuse ChainLedger idempotency index; no second mutable spend-set/fold in verifier.
recommended_design.atomic_api: Add a generic ChainLedger reserve_once(record) operation using the existing index/_commit/barrier implementation. Under the same ledger-owned reentrant transition lock shared by append/append_many/barrier/close/snapshot: validate writable healthy verified writer and record; existing same-id/same-payload returns an already-present result with NO permission; existing different payload refuses; missing id appends and unconditionally barriers then returns newly-reserved seq. Verifier only delegates on newly-reserved in that invocation. Existing append idempotency semantics remain unchanged.
recommended_design.read_api: Read-only query of the same record ID returns absent/present/conflict or damaged/unknown, plus existing immutable record evidence. Use existing scan/verify or a small public indexed lookup owned by ChainLedger; no cross-module private index access. A query result never authorizes a retry. Ordinary reading opens remain no-lock/no-repair.
capture_order: Validate exact facade/driver/authority/store binding and complete immutable verified admission/plan/port context before any reserve.
Atomically reserve admission_use and barrier through the existing sole ledger writer.
Only the call receiving newly-reserved invokes existing authority.capture once; existing P6 final effect checks remain authoritative.
After reservation, any delegate error or unknown result leaves it spent. No delete, rollback, unspend, retry, or fresh constructor escape.
recommended_design.recovery: Before accepting a reopened writer, verify sequence/hash chain AND namespace/payload digest consistency plus duplicate IDs; do not trust _open index reconstruction alone. On any uncertain append/sync/fold error quarantine the writer for all further writes, never inspect a stale index and retry. Close/reopen through trusted owner, recover only incomplete final line using JsonlLedger, then verify/rebuild before new claims. A complete valid reservation is spent even if append raised. If no complete reservation survived and no barrier acknowledgement occurred, no delegation could have begun; a later verified fresh reserve may proceed. Sealed/interior or complete corrupt records refuse; no repair by erasing spend.
recommended_design.unknown_outcome: Reservation proves spent, not that capture completed. Query the existing capture authority for exact matching committed evidence if it can provide it; otherwise report spent/outcome-unknown and stop. Do not reconstruct opaque live handles from a JSONL audit record. Crash after reserve/barrier but before delegate may yield zero capture effects permanently. No automatic recovery sender.
recommended_design.guarantee: Exactly one durable admission reservation and at most one delegated capture attempt per verified admission in the configured namespace. NOT exactly one broker effect across a reserve/delegate crash gap. No OS-owned external broker or malicious filesystem rollback guarantee.
recommended_design.p4: No double spend of authorize_capture_set, no second CAPTURED/CONSUMED writer. Existing same-ledger P4 transaction/receipt owner remains intact. Direct F4 broker.capture remains its accepted lower-level lifecycle API, not an F5a admission route; do not claim global prevention of every possible direct broker call.
